values.name: Breakbulk
values.description: Defines the movement of general cargo not carried in ISO standard containers.

values.name: LCL/LCL
values.description: Defines the movement of cargo packed in and unpacked from containers by the carrier on behalf of the shipper/consignee. 'LCL' means Less than Container Load.

values.name: FCL/FCL
values.description: Defines the movement of cargo packed by the shipper or shipper's agent and unpacked by the consignee or consignee's agent. 'FCL' means Full Container Load.

values.name: FCL/LCL
values.description: Defines the movement of cargo packed by the shipper or shipper's agent and unpacked by the carrier. 'FCL' means Full Container Load. 'LCL' means Less than Container Load.

values.name: LCL/FCL
values.description: Defines the movement of cargo packed by the carrier and unpacked by the consignee or consignee's agent. 'LCL' means Less than Container Load. 'FCL' means Full Load.

values.name: House to house
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit by the shipper at point of origin and unpacked by consignee at final destination.

values.name: House to terminal
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit by the shipper at point of origin and unpacked at the carrier's inland facility between the ship's point of discharge and the final destination.

values.name: House to pier
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit by the shipper at point of origin and unpacked by carrier at ship's point of discharge (pier).

values.name: Terminal to house
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at a carrier's inland facility between point of origin and the ship's point of loading and unpacked by consignee at the final destination.

values.name: Terminal to terminal
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at a carrier's inland facility between point of origin and the ship's point of loading and unpacked at a carrier's inland facility between ship's point of discharge and final destination.

values.name: Terminal to pier
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at a carrier's inland facility between point of origin and ship's point of loading and unpacked by carrier at ship's point of discharge (pier).

values.name: Pier to house
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at ship's point of loading and unpacked by consignee at final destination.

values.name: Pier to terminal
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at ship's point of loading and unpacked at a carrier's inland facility between ship's point of discharge and final destination.

values.name: Pier to pier
values.description: Cargo packed in a unit at ship's point of loading and unpacked by carrier at ship's point of discharge (pier).
